It peaks on the head/stem token itself and fires identically no matter how the word or phrase actually continues. Its amplitude is boosted by quantitative or technical wider context (adult versus trial period, medical prose), while matched precise-unit nouns (dozen, percent, minute), generic nouns (water, system, problem, result) and unrelated stems (electr-, archae-) stay near zero; its output direction shows no specific-token prediction (Jacobian kurtosis ~3.4, 0% lens agreement), so it prepares no particular upcoming token.
